name: Yixianornis
isnote: PBDB places it in Hongshanornithidae; the Songlingornithidae revision cited includes it in that group's cladogram.
sum: Ornithuromorph from the Jiufotang Formation at Chaoyang with a modern fan of tail feathers.
wsnote: IVPP V12631 is about 19–20 cm long (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: IVPP V12631, with wing and tail feather impressions.
biology: Preserves eight long tail feathers in a modern fan arrangement.
author: Zhou and Zhang 2001
